rationale: All three review lenses ran successfully (blind, edge-case, acceptance). The edge-case lens traced every branch combination (search empty/non-empty, defaultModel null/set, isGrouped true/false) and found the fix correct in all of them, with no stale-memoization risk. The acceptance lens confirmed all 5 Jira ACs pass against the diff and the 49/49 passing test suite, with only 2 minor (non-blocking) informational notes about search-view label behavior and an untested search+router combination — both pre-existing design choices, not regressions, and dropped in triage per minor severity. The blind lens (diff-only, no repo context) raised 5 concerns; all were checked against the full file and the actual passing test run and did not hold up: (1)/(2) assumed the Recommended-row push condition could drift out of sync with recommendedShown, but both are driven by the exact same !search && defaultModel condition in the real file; (3) misread the keyboard-nav test by conflating two different tests' key-press counts (the actual test does 5 total ArrowDown presses, wrapping 5 items back to Default, which is correct and already verified passing); (4)/(5) worried about shared-fixture regressions and unverified existing fixtures, both already empirically refuted by the full test file passing 49/49 after the change, including every sibling test in the touched describe blocks. No critical or major findings survived. Standards: the commit (after a local amend to fix initial casing) matches the project's `EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence` format; no code-quality guide exists in this repo; the diff touches no HTML sink, navigation, cross-window message, or secret per security-patterns.md, so no security concern applies.
